name: zoom-slider
title: Zoom Slider
description: Infinitely looping horizontal image carousel where the active card expands using a quadratic easing curve as it enters from the right. Supports scroll, drag, and touch. Hover reveals GSAP SplitText line animations above each card.

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support and customizable slider content.

props.name: scaleOnHover
props.description: Enables the image scale-up effect on hover.

props.name: textOnHover
props.description: Enables the hover text reveal above each slide.

props.name: size
props.description: Multiplier applied to zoom slider card width and height.

props.name: easeScrollPercentage
props.description: Percentage of viewport distance used by the horizontal easing curve.
